headline: OpenAI releases country-level work-activity classifications of consumer ChatGPT use
summary: OpenAI Economic Research released Signals v3.0, a public dataset and methodology describing consumer ChatGPT messages classified into work activities mapped to 165 O*NET Intermediate Work Activities across nearly 100 countries. Quarterly series span Q1 2025–Q3 2026. OpenAI reports that, across 74 countries observed in every quarter, the ten most common activities accounted for an average 51.1% of classified work messages in Q3 2026, down from 56.0% in Q1 2025. The dataset covers individual consumer plans, not enterprise messages or Codex; the work and activity labels are automated model classifications. The release measures message mix, not employment, task completion, productivity or labor-market effects.
